newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney 1995/96 profit 202 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney 1995/96 profit 202 mln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Income before lease and fin charges 724 vs 467
Theme park and resort revenues 4,968 vs 4,572
NOTE - Euro Disney, 39 percent owned by The Walt Disney Co, reported its annual results in a statement.
It said theme park revenues increased nine percent to 2.7 billion francs, and hotel revenues increased 11 percent to 2.0 billion.
"The increase in attendance, together with a slight increase in guest spending on food and merchandise, largely offset the reduced park entry prices which were introduced in April 1995," it said.
Net equity increased to 5.8 billion francs from 5.6 billion.
Total borrowings, including the debt of the unconsolidated financing companies, remained stable at 15.1 billion francs.
The group's cash position increased to approximately 1.2 billion francs, and it has available an unused 1.1 billion franc credit facility from The Walt Disney Co.
